voroColumnFlow.targetPath.description: Relative path to the dbt target directory (contains manifest.json)

enumDescriptions: Show every time the extension activates
voroColumnFlow.welcomeBanner.description: When to open the VORO welcome banner terminal on activation

voroColumnFlow.ai.enabled.description: Off by default. When on, a 'Resolve with AI' button appears on edges the SQL parser could not resolve. Clicking it sends that edge's model/column names and the target model's SQL to the endpoint configured below — nothing else, and only when clicked.

enumDescriptions: OpenAI-compatible chat completions API — also covers OpenRouter, Groq, Mistral, DeepSeek, Together, Ollama, LM Studio, and most self-hosted servers

Azure AI Foundry model-catalog / serverless deployment (a *.services.ai.azure.com or *.models.ai.azure.com endpoint). Not a classic *.openai.azure.com resource — that uses a different auth/URL shape and isn't supported
voroColumnFlow.ai.apiFormat.description: Wire format of the endpoint below

voroColumnFlow.ai.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the AI endpoint, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1, https://api.anthropic.com, https://<name>.services.ai.azure.com, or a local server such as http://localhost:11434/v1

voroColumnFlow.ai.model.description: Model name to request, e.g. gpt-4o-mini, claude-haiku-4-5, llama3.1 — for Azure, this is your deployment name

voroColumnFlow.ai.azureApiVersion.description: Only used when apiFormat is 'azure'. The api-version query param the Azure AI Model Inference API expects — check your Azure AI Foundry deployment's docs/quickstart code sample for the current value, this default may be outdated
